label: Unemployment rate (LAUS)
definition: Unemployed persons as a percent of the civilian labor force age 16+, by place of residence.
table_or_series: LAU{area_code}03, e.g., LAUCN180890000000003 (Lake County IN), LAUCT182700000000003 (Gary city IN), LAUST180000000000003 (Indiana), LAURD920000000000003 (Midwest region)
variables: measure_code 03; seasonal U (S also for states, regions, divisions and some metros); period M13 = annual average
comparable_span: 1990-2025 for counties and metros on 2025 geography; 1976-2025 for states
breaks: 2015 redesign (substate revised back to 2010 only); March 2025 re-estimation on OMB 2023 geography with CT planning regions carried back to 1990; Oct 2025 missing and 2025 annual average is an 11-month average (footnote G)
suppression: None; '-' with footnote X for Oct 2025
limitations: For aggregates recompute as sum(measure 04) / sum(measure 06); city values are disaggregated from counties; no error measures published.

label: Unemployed persons (LAUS)
definition: Residents age 16+ with no job who were available for and actively seeking work (CPS concept), estimated for the area.
breaks: Same as unemployment_rate_laus
suppression: None; '-' with footnote X for Oct 2025
limitations: Sum only non-overlapping areas (cities and city parts overlap counties).

label: Employed persons (LAUS)
definition: Residents age 16+ who worked during the reference week (CPS concept), estimated for the area.
breaks: Same as unemployment_rate_laus
suppression: None; '-' with footnote X for Oct 2025
limitations: Counts employed residents (by residence), not jobs in the area.

label: Civilian labor force (LAUS)
definition: Employed plus unemployed residents age 16+.
breaks: Same as unemployment_rate_laus
suppression: None; '-' with footnote X for Oct 2025
limitations: Level shifts can reflect population-control and method updates rather than real change.

label: Labor force participation rate (LAUS)
definition: Civilian labor force as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+.
variables: measure_code 08; population measure_code 09 (not seasonally adjusted only); period M13
geo_levels: state;other:New York city;other:Los Angeles-Long Beach-Glendale metropolitan division
breaks: March 2025 intercensal population controls replaced published population series from 1976; Oct 2025 missing
limitations: Published only for states, DC and two modeled substate areas; not available for counties or most cities.

label: Employment-population ratio (LAUS)
definition: Employed persons as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+.
geo_levels: state;other:New York city;other:Los Angeles-Long Beach-Glendale metropolitan division
breaks: Same as labor_force_participation_rate_laus
limitations: States and two modeled substate areas only.

label: Unemployment rate, United States (CPS)
definition: National unemployment rate for the civilian population age 16+ from the Current Population Survey; the national comparator for LAUS areas.
table_or_series: LNU04000000 (not seasonally adjusted; M13 annual average); LNS14000000 (seasonally adjusted)
variables: period M13 = annual average (stored with the monthly NSA series)
breaks: Population controls updated each January; Oct 2025 not collected; 2025 annual average is an 11-month average (footnote 11)
limitations: LAUS publishes no U.S. total; use this series for national comparisons.

label: Labor force participation rate, United States (CPS)
definition: Civilian labor force as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+, national.
breaks: Population controls updated each January; 2025 annual average excludes October
limitations: National only.

label: Employment-population ratio, United States (CPS)
definition: Employed persons as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+, national.
breaks: Population controls updated each January; 2025 annual average excludes October
limitations: National only.

label: Unemployment rate (ACS)
definition: Unemployed as a percent of the civilian labor force age 16+, from ACS employment status.
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release; Connecticut planning regions replace counties in recent vintages
suppression: 90% MOE published; 1-year only for areas of 65,000+
limitations: Differs from LAUS/CPS in timing and design; use LAUS for current local rates and ACS for small areas and subgroups.

label: Labor force participation rate (ACS)
definition: Population 16+ in the labor force (including Armed Forces) as a percent of population 16+.
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release; Connecticut planning regions replace counties in recent vintages
limitations: Includes Armed Forces in the numerator; use B23025_003 for a civilian-only rate.

label: Employment-population ratio (ACS)
definition: Civilian employed as a percent of population 16+.
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release; Connecticut planning regions replace counties in recent vintages
limitations: Age structure strongly affects the ratio; compare with age-specific tables (B23001) when possible.

label: Median earnings of workers (ACS)
definition: Median earnings in the past 12 months for the population 16+ with earnings; full-time, year-round medians are available only by sex in B20017 (no both-sexes full-time median).
breaks: Dollar year changes with each release; no standard 2020 1-year release
limitations: For aggregated areas re-estimate from the earnings distribution (B20005), not by averaging medians.

label: Industry of employed residents (ACS)
definition: Civilian employed residents 16+ by industry sector of their job wherever located. C24030 is split by sex, so both-sexes counts require male + female lines (female line = male line + 27; subsectors follow the same offset, e.g., health care 023+050); C24050_002-C24050_014 give both-sexes sector totals directly.
variables: C24030_001;C24030_003+C24030_030 (agriculture, forestry, fishing, hunting, mining);C24030_006+C24030_033 (construction);C24030_007+C24030_034 (manufacturing);C24030_008+C24030_035 (wholesale trade);C24030_009+C24030_036 (retail trade);C24030_010+C24030_037 (transportation, warehousing, utilities);C24030_013+C24030_040 (information);C24030_014+C24030_041 (finance, insurance, real estate);C24030_017+C24030_044 (professional, scientific, management, administrative);C24030_021+C24030_048 (educational services, health care, social assistance);C24030_024+C24030_051 (arts, recreation, accommodation, food);C24030_027+C24030_054 (other services);C24030_028+C24030_055 (public administration);alternative C24050_002 to C24050_014
breaks: Census industry code lists are revised periodically; check category comparability
suppression: 90% MOE published; C24050 not published for block groups
limitations: Resident-based: describes where residents work by industry, not jobs located in the area (use QCEW, CBP or LODES WAC for local jobs); approximate MOEs of male+female sums with root-sum-of-squares.

label: Occupation of employed residents (ACS)
definition: Civilian employed residents 16+ by major occupation group. C24010 is split by sex: male detail lines 003-037 pair with female lines 039-073 (offset +36); C24050 block headers give both-sexes group totals.
variables: C24010_001;C24010_003+C24010_039 (management, business, science, arts);C24010_019+C24010_055 (service);C24010_027+C24010_063 (sales and office);C24010_030+C24010_066 (natural resources, construction, maintenance);C24010_034+C24010_070 (production, transportation, material moving);alternative C24050_015, C24050_029, C24050_043, C24050_057, C24050_071
breaks: Census occupation code lists are revised periodically; check category comparability
limitations: Resident-based; approximate MOEs of male+female sums with root-sum-of-squares.

label: Covered employment, all industries (QCEW)
definition: Annual average of monthly employment in UI/UCFE-covered jobs located in the area, all ownerships.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; own_code 0, industry_code 10, size_code 0 (agglvl_code 70 county, 50 state, 40 MSA, 30 CSA, 10 U.S.)
universe: Jobs covered by state UI and federal UCFE programs
breaks: Connecticut planning regions from 2024 (counties through 2023); MSA publication reduced to totals from 2025 Q2
limitations: Jobs by worksite, not residents; excludes work not covered by UI/UCFE such as self-employment.

label: Establishments (QCEW)
definition: Annual average number of establishments with UI/UCFE-covered employment in the area.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; own_code 0 or 5, industry_code 10 or NAICS
breaks: Same as covered_employment_qcew
suppression: Establishment counts can remain visible when employment and wages are suppressed
limitations: Multi-establishment reporting practices affect counts; not comparable to CBP establishment counts.

label: Average annual pay per job (QCEW)
definition: Total annual wages divided by annual average employment for covered jobs located in the area.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; own_code 0 (or 5 for private), industry_code 10
universe: Jobs covered by state UI and federal UCFE programs
breaks: Same as covered_employment_qcew
limitations: Pay per job, not per worker; affected by part-time share and industry mix; nominal dollars (adjust with CPI-U or R-CPI-U-RS).

label: Employment by industry (QCEW)
definition: Annual average covered employment by NAICS sector or supersector; private sector (own_code 5) with government by ownership.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; county private NAICS sectors agglvl_code 74 (supersectors 73); government own_code 1, 2, 3 at agglvl_code 71
variables: annual_avg_emplvl by industry_code (e.g., 31-33 manufacturing, 62 health care)
breaks: SIC to NAICS (NAICS history before 2001 reconstructed); MSA industry detail not published from 2025 Q2
suppression: Many detailed cells flagged N (786 of 1,773 rows for Lake County IN 2025)
limitations: Suppressed sectors must be shown as not disclosed, not zero.

label: Employment location quotient by industry (QCEW)
definition: Industry share of local covered employment divided by the same share for the U.S.
breaks: Same as employment_by_industry_qcew
limitations: Relative specialization only; unstable for small industries.

label: Nonfarm payroll jobs (CES State and Area)
definition: Monthly estimate of nonfarm payroll jobs located in the state or metro area, total and by industry where published.
table_or_series: SM{U|S}{state 2}{area 5}{industry 8}{data type 2}, e.g., SMU18294140000000001 (total nonfarm, Lake County-Porter County-Jasper County IN Metro Division, NSA)
variables: data_type 01 (all employees, thousands); industry 00000000 = total nonfarm; period M13 = annual average
breaks: Annual benchmark revisions; OMB metro delineation updates
limitations: No county estimates; recent months preliminary.

label: Employment by occupation (OEWS)
definition: Estimated wage-and-salary employment by detailed occupation (SOC) in the area, May reference period.
universe: Nonfarm wage and salary jobs (excludes self-employed)
breaks: Occupation (SOC) and area definition changes; BLS cautions against time-series use
limitations: Not designed for trends; no county data; excludes self-employed.

label: Median annual wage by occupation (OEWS)
definition: Median annual wage for an occupation in the area (hourly median x 2,080 where hourly wages are published).
universe: Nonfarm wage and salary jobs in the occupation
breaks: Wage data from older panels are aged to the current reference period
suppression: Top-coded at $115.00/hour or $239,200/year (footnote 5); footnote 8 estimate not released
limitations: Not designed for trends.

label: Mean annual wage by occupation (OEWS)
definition: Mean annual wage for an occupation in the area.
universe: Nonfarm wage and salary jobs in the occupation
breaks: Same as median_annual_wage_oews
limitations: Weight by occupational employment (datatype 01) when combining.

label: Personal income (BEA)
definition: Total income received by or on behalf of residents: earnings, dividends/interest/rent and transfer receipts, less social insurance contributions, plus residence adjustment.
breaks: Connecticut geography switch in 2024; Alaska area changes; Broomfield CO from 2002
limitations: Current dollars; BEA U.S. total is the sum of states and DC.

label: Per capita personal income (BEA, counties)
definition: Personal income divided by BEA midyear resident population.
variables: LineCode 3 (dollars); components LineCode 1 (thousands of dollars) and LineCode 2 (persons)
breaks: Same as personal_income_bea; population vintage changes each release
limitations: Aggregate by summing LineCodes 1 and 2 before dividing; includes income not available to households (e.g., employer insurance contributions).

label: Per capita personal income (BEA, states)
definition: State personal income divided by midyear population.
breaks: Revisions each release; population vintage differs from the county (CAINC1) release
limitations: Use one release for both state and county values when showing parents together.

label: Real per capita personal income (BEA, states)
definition: State per capita personal income in constant 2017 dollars, adjusted for regional price levels and inflation using BEA's real personal income method.
variables: LineCode 2 (constant 2017 dollars); LineCode 1 real personal income (millions of 2017 dollars)
breaks: Whole series revised each release
limitations: States only; mixes spatial and temporal price adjustment.

label: Personal current transfer receipts as share of personal income (BEA)
definition: Government transfer receipts (Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, income maintenance, unemployment insurance, veterans and other) as a percent of personal income.
variables: LineCode 50 (transfer receipts); LineCode 10 (personal income); LineCode 130 (per capita transfers)
breaks: Same as personal_income_bea
limitations: Includes Medicare/Medicaid in-kind benefits, so it is not a poverty indicator by itself.

label: Income maintenance benefits per capita (BEA)
definition: Income maintenance benefits (largely SSI, EITC, family assistance, general assistance, WIC, SNAP and other assistance) per resident.
breaks: Program changes (e.g., SNAP, EITC) shift levels; Connecticut geography switch 2024
limitations: Program dollars, not recipients; nominal dollars.

label: Earnings by place of work (BEA)
definition: Wages and salaries, supplements and proprietors' income earned in the county's jobs, before residence adjustment.
table_or_series: CAINC4 LineCode 35 (wages and salaries LineCode 50; proprietors' income LineCode 70)
variables: LineCode 35; LineCode 50; LineCode 60; LineCode 70; LineCode 42 (adjustment for residence)
breaks: Same as personal_income_bea
limitations: Workplace-based complement to resident personal income; the residence adjustment (LineCode 42) shows net commuter earnings flow.

label: Earnings by NAICS industry (BEA)
definition: Earnings by place of work by NAICS industry (e.g., LineCode 1000 finance and insurance; 2000 government and government enterprises).
variables: Industry LineCodes per CAINC5N definition file
breaks: SIC to NAICS break at 2001; Connecticut geography switch 2024
suppression: (D) heavy in small counties (67,619 cells in the CAINC5N Indiana file); (NA)
limitations: Suppressed industries must be shown as not disclosed.

label: Gross domestic product, current dollars (BEA, counties)
definition: Value added by production located in the county, in current dollars.
breaks: Connecticut planning regions from 2024; metro GDP discontinued (sum counties instead)
limitations: Not a measure of resident income; volatile for small counties dominated by one industry.

label: Real GDP (BEA, counties)
definition: County GDP in chained 2017 dollars and its chain-type quantity index; used for real growth rates.
table_or_series: CAGDP1 LineCode 1 (real GDP); LineCode 2 (quantity index); CAGDP9 by industry
breaks: Reference-year and comprehensive-update revisions; Connecticut 2024 switch
limitations: Chained dollars are not additive; compare growth rates rather than levels across areas.

label: GDP by industry (BEA, counties)
definition: Current-dollar GDP by NAICS sector and industry groups (e.g., LineCode 12 manufacturing; 70 health care and social assistance; 83 government).
variables: LineCode 1 all industry total; 2 private industries; sector LineCodes per CAGDP2 definition file
breaks: Same as gdp_current_dollars_bea
suppression: (D) not shown to avoid disclosure (10,337 cells in the CAGDP2 Indiana file); (NA); (NM)
limitations: Industry detail heavily suppressed for small counties.

label: Regional Price Parity (BEA)
definition: Price level of an area relative to the U.S. average (U.S. = 100) for all items and components (goods; housing; utilities; other services).
table_or_series: SARPP (states), MARPP (MSAs), PARPP (metro/nonmetro portions); LineCode 1 all items
variables: LineCode 1 all items; 2 goods; 3 services: housing; 4 services: utilities; 5 services: other
geo_levels: nation;state;cbsa;other:metro and nonmetro portions of states
breaks: Full series revised each release
limitations: Spatial price levels for a single year; not an inflation index; no county or city values.

label: Median household income (ACS)
definition: Median household income in the past 12 months, in inflation-adjusted dollars of the final year of the period.
comparable_span: Non-overlapping periods after R-CPI-U-RS adjustment (Census factor 1.23070782 converts 2015-2019 to 2024 dollars)
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release; Connecticut planning regions replace counties in recent vintages
suppression: 90% MOE published; 1-year only for areas of 65,000+
limitations: For combined areas re-estimate from B19001 bins; do not average medians.

label: Household income distribution (ACS)
definition: Households by income in the past 12 months across 16 brackets.
comparable_span: Non-overlapping 5-year periods, but fixed nominal brackets are not inflation-consistent
breaks: Values are in each period's dollars while bracket bounds stay fixed
limitations: Open-ended top bracket ($200,000+); use Pareto or linear interpolation for derived medians.

label: Mean household income (ACS)
definition: Aggregate household income divided by number of households.
breaks: Dollar year changes with each release
suppression: 90% MOE published (ratio MOE must be approximated)
limitations: Sensitive to very high incomes; pair with the median.

label: Per capita income (ACS)
definition: Aggregate income of persons 15+ divided by total population.
breaks: Dollar year changes with each release
limitations: Money income only; differs conceptually from BEA per capita personal income.

label: Gini index of household income inequality (ACS)
definition: Gini index of household income (0 = perfect equality, 1 = maximal inequality).
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release
suppression: 90% MOE published; not published for block groups
limitations: Cannot be combined across areas.

label: Poverty rate, all people (ACS)
definition: Share of people whose family or individual income in the past 12 months was below the official poverty threshold.
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release; Connecticut planning regions replace counties in recent vintages
suppression: 90% MOE published; B17001 not published for block groups
limitations: Official poverty thresholds do not vary by local cost of living; excludes people in institutions, college dorms and military quarters and unrelated children under 15.

label: Poverty rate by age group (ACS)
definition: Share below poverty for age groups under 6, 6-11, 12-17, 18-59, 60-74, 75-84 and 85+.
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release
suppression: 90% MOE published; not published for block groups
limitations: Child rate (0-17) = sum of B17020_003 to _005 over the same age groups at all income levels.

label: People below 200% of poverty (ACS)
definition: Share of people with income-to-poverty ratio under 2.00 (a common low-income or near-poor measure).
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release
limitations: Uses national poverty thresholds, not local costs.

label: Households receiving SNAP (ACS)
definition: Share of households that received Food Stamps/SNAP in the past 12 months.
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release
suppression: 90% MOE published; not published for block groups
limitations: Survey-reported receipt over 12 months; can differ from administrative SNAP caseload counts.

label: Households with cash public assistance income (ACS)
definition: Share of households receiving cash public assistance income (e.g., TANF, general assistance) in the past 12 months.
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release
limitations: Excludes SSI and SNAP (use B19056 and B22001).

label: Households with Supplemental Security Income (ACS)
definition: Share of households with SSI income in the past 12 months.
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release
limitations: Household receipt, not number of recipients.

label: Poverty rate, all ages (SAIPE)
definition: Model-based percent of people in poverty for the calendar year.
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: CPS-to-ACS input switch between 2004 and 2005; Connecticut planning regions from 2022
limitations: Preferred over ACS 1-year for small counties' single-year rates; aggregate counts (SAEPOVALL_PT / SAEPOVU_ALL) but intervals cannot be combined.

label: People in poverty, all ages (SAIPE)
definition: Model-based count of people in poverty.
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
comparable_span: 2005-2024 (ACS-based; counts not comparable across the 2010 benchmark per SAIPE cautions)
breaks: CPS-to-ACS switch 2004-2005; 2010 census benchmark; Connecticut planning regions from 2022
limitations: Summed county counts have no published interval.

label: Poverty rate, ages 0-17 (SAIPE)
definition: Model-based percent of children 0-17 in poverty; related children 5-17 in families also published.
universe: Children 0-17 for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: Same as poverty_rate_saipe
limitations: Ages 0-4 poverty (SAEPOVRT0_4_PT) exists only for states and the nation.

label: Median household income (SAIPE)
definition: Model-based single-year median household income in nominal dollars of the estimate year.
breaks: CPS-to-ACS switch 2004-2005; Connecticut planning regions from 2022
limitations: Nominal dollars; not directly comparable to ACS 5-year medians.

label: Employer establishments (CBP)
definition: Number of employer establishments by NAICS industry at their physical location, as of the reference year.
breaks: SIC to NAICS 1998; NAICS vintage updates; 2017 publication rule (<3 establishments withheld); Connecticut planning regions from 2022
suppression: Cells with fewer than 3 establishments withheld (2017+)
limitations: Excludes self-employed, most government, agricultural production and railroads.

label: Mid-March employment (CBP)
definition: Paid employees in the pay period including March 12, by NAICS industry at establishment location.
breaks: Same as establishments_cbp
suppression: Noise flags G, H, J; withheld cells (2017+)
limitations: Single mid-March snapshot; noise infused.

label: Annual payroll per employee (CBP)
definition: Annual payroll divided by mid-March employment for employer establishments.
breaks: Same as establishments_cbp
limitations: Payroll over a year divided by a March headcount; nominal dollars.

label: Establishments by employment size class (CBP)
definition: Employer establishments by number of employees (<5, 5-9, 10-19, 20-49, 50-99, 100-249, 250-499, 500-999, 1,000+).
breaks: Same as establishments_cbp
suppression: N = not available or not comparable
limitations: Establishment size, not firm size (use SUSB for enterprise size).

label: Firms, establishments and employment by enterprise size (SUSB)
definition: Firms, establishments, March employment and payroll classified by the size of the whole enterprise (e.g., <20, <500 employees).
variables: FIRM;ESTB;EMPL;PAYR;RCPT (years ending 2 and 7);ENTRSIZE with ENTRSIZEDSCR labels (e.g., 01: Total, 02: <5, 03: 5-9, 05: <20)
breaks: NAICS vintage changes
limitations: Firm counts in subnational areas count a multi-location firm in each area where it operates, so they do not sum to the U.S.

label: Employer firms by owner sex, race, ethnicity and veteran status (ABS)
definition: Number of employer firms and their sales, employment and payroll classified by owner characteristics.
comparable_span: Within ABS reference years (category changes possible)
breaks: NAICS2022 coding in 2023 data
limitations: Survey estimates with sizeable RSEs at county level.

label: Nonemployer businesses (NES)
definition: Number of businesses with no paid employees (mostly sole proprietors) by NAICS industry.
universe: Nonemployer businesses filing business income tax returns
breaks: NAICS vintage changes; Connecticut planning regions in recent files
limitations: Counts businesses, not people; includes part-time and side businesses.

label: Nonemployer receipts (NES)
definition: Sales, value of shipments or revenue of nonemployer businesses.
breaks: NAICS vintage changes
suppression: RCPTOT_F S = suppressed; noise flags G, H, J
limitations: Receipts are noise-infused; nominal dollars.

label: Business applications (BFS, annual by county)
definition: Number of business applications in the county during the year.
variables: BA2005 to BA2025 (columns); County Code (5-digit FIPS)
breaks: Connecticut geography switch 2022; differentially private noise in the 2026 release
suppression: Differentially private noise; no cell suppression observed
limitations: Applications are not business starts; large 2020-2021 surge.

label: Establishment entry and exit rates (BDS)
definition: Establishments born or exited in the last 12 months as a percent of establishments (BDS definitions).
breaks: Whole time series re-released each year
suppression: Flag variables in API; cells withheld for disclosure
limitations: Volatile for small counties; use multi-year averages.

label: Job creation, destruction and net job creation rates (BDS)
definition: Jobs created by opening/expanding and lost by closing/contracting establishments over 12 months, as rates of the DHS denominator.
breaks: Whole time series re-released each year
suppression: Flag variables in API; cells withheld for disclosure
limitations: Rates use the DHS denominator (DENOM); recompute from counts and denom when aggregating.

label: Jobs by industry sector at workplace (LODES WAC)
definition: Count of jobs by 2-digit NAICS sector at the workplace census block, aggregable to small areas.
universe: Jobs covered by LEHD (UI-covered; federal jobs from 2010)
breaks: Federal jobs added 2010; LODES8 on 2020 blocks
limitations: Job counts differ from QCEW/CBP; choose JT00 vs JT01 consistently.

label: Jobs by monthly earnings band at workplace (LODES WAC)
definition: Jobs with earnings of $1,250/month or less (CE01), $1,251-$3,333 (CE02) and over $3,333 (CE03).
comparable_span: Limited: thresholds are nominal and unchanged since 2002
breaks: Inflation erodes fixed thresholds over time
limitations: Not inflation-adjusted; shares drift upward mechanically.

label: Average monthly earnings of stable jobs (QWI)
definition: Average monthly earnings of employees with stable (full-quarter) jobs, by industry and worker characteristics.
universe: Stable (full-quarter) jobs at employers in the area
breaks: Release-specific revisions
suppression: Status flags: 5 suppressed; 9 fuzzed value released
limitations: Weight by EmpS when combining areas; nominal dollars.

label: Adjusted gross income per tax return (IRS SOI)
definition: Total AGI divided by number of individual income tax returns filed from the area.
comparable_span: 2011-2023 in current CSV format; earlier years as Excel
breaks: Tax law and filing population changes
limitations: Filers only; mean is skewed by high incomes.

label: Tax returns by AGI size class (IRS SOI)
definition: Number of individual returns in each of 8 AGI size classes (agi_stub 1-8).
comparable_span: Within years using the same class boundaries
breaks: AGI class boundaries set per year in the users guide
limitations: Nominal class boundaries.

label: Adults in households with difficulty paying usual expenses (HPS/HTOPS)
definition: Share of adults 18+ reporting it was somewhat or very difficult to pay usual household expenses.
variables: Columns: Not at all difficult; A little difficult; Somewhat difficult; Very difficult; Did not report
universe: Population 18 years and older in households
breaks: Reference period 'last 7 days' (HPS through June 2025 HTOPS) vs 'last two months' (2026 HTOPS); HTOPS tables national only
limitations: Experimental; exclude 'did not report' consistently when computing shares.

label: Household food insufficiency (HPS/HTOPS)
definition: Share of adults in households that sometimes or often did not have enough to eat in the reference period.
variables: Food sufficiency categories (enough; not always the kinds wanted; sometimes not enough; often not enough)
universe: Population 18 years and older in households
breaks: Question and design changes across HPS phases and HTOPS; HTOPS tables national only
limitations: Experimental; category wording should be checked per cycle.

label: Household food security status (SIPP)
definition: Food security status from the SIPP food security module (recode of affirmative responses).
variables: RFOODS (food security status);RFOODR (raw score);EFOOD3 (cut or skipped meals)
breaks: Panel and item changes across files
suppression: None published; compute SEs with replicate weights
limitations: National microdata; requires weighting and replicate-weight variance.

label: Unable to pay rent/mortgage or utilities (SIPP)
definition: Share of people in households that were unable to pay rent or mortgage (EAWBMORT) or utility bills (EAWBGAS) during the reference year.
universe: Persons in SIPP households (adult well-being items)
breaks: Item wording and universe can change by file
suppression: None published; compute SEs with replicate weights
limitations: National only; confirm item universe in the schema each year.

label: Households below the ALICE Threshold (United For ALICE)
definition: Share of households with income below the ALICE Threshold (households in poverty plus ALICE households) in the county.
table_or_series: State ALICE data sheets (e.g., 2026 ALICE - Indiana Data Sheet.xlsx)
variables: Below ALICE Threshold share; poverty share; ALICE share (per data sheet)
breaks: Methodology revised across report years
limitations: Reuse requires written permission; not an official statistic.

label: Food insecurity rate, overall and child (Map the Meal Gap)
definition: Modeled share of the population (and of children) living in food-insecure households.
table_or_series: Map the Meal Gap dataset (by request)
variables: Overall food insecurity rate; child food insecurity rate; food budget shortfall; cost per meal
comparable_span: Check technical briefs for method changes
breaks: Methodology refined across releases
limitations: Model-based; dataset access by request; license terms not verified.

label: CPI-U annual average, U.S. city average all items
definition: Annual average of the CPI-U all items index (1982-84=100), used to convert nominal dollars between years.
breaks: Oct 2025 not published; 2025 annual average = mean of 11 months (321.943)

label: R-CPI-U-RS annual average (inflation factor for ACS dollars)
definition: Annual average of the retroactive CPI-U research series (December 1977 = 100); factor = index(target year) / index(source year).
breaks: Annual vintage updates can revise recent values; Oct 2025 missing
limitations: Record the vintage used; Census published factors (1.02937903 for 2023 to 2024; 1.23070782 for 2019 to 2024) may differ slightly from recomputed ratios.
